parts.text: Can you pull up the big transfer from January? I need it for my accountant.

Writing it out now.
Saved to reports/january-transfers.csv — one row, the $2,450.00 transfer from Maple Everyday Checking (4417).
The landlord also emailed a statement PDF. Can you read it?
Reading the statement.
